archived_contracts.x16_alpha_note: The archived ridge_bridge used a fixed alpha 1000; this campaign's budget allows only the nested {1,10,100} grid, so B3 selects inside that grid
archived_contracts.x16_structural: adjusted_structural_bvps_pb_6m = ridge_bridge__no_change_pb on x9 bvps_lags; x12 adjusted target (future BVPS + dividends paid in the next h report months) / current BVPS - 1; P/B held at its current value
archived_contracts.x17_persistent: BVPS plus cumulative dividends; the x12 adjusted target is the same idea over each forecast window
archived_contracts.x23_excess: x18/x23: November post-policy origin, December 1 to next February 28/29 cash minus the median positive payment <= .25 in the prior 24 months (v200 freezes it at the November origin), divided by the latest filed November BVPS; conditional positive-excess survivor to_current_bvps

extraction_sql.dividends: SELECT ex_date,amount FROM daily_dividends WHERE ticker='PGR' AND ex_date < ? ORDER BY ex_date
extraction_sql.first_reported: SELECT month_end,field,value_real,filing_date FROM pgr_edgar_monthly_first_reported WHERE month_end < ? AND filing_date < ? AND field IN ('book_value_per_share','combined_ratio','pif_total','net_premiums_written','roe_net_income_ttm','investment_book_yield') ORDER BY month_end,field
extraction_sql.prices: SELECT date,close FROM daily_prices WHERE ticker='PGR' AND date < ? ORDER BY date
extraction_sql.reports: SELECT month_end,filing_date,book_value_per_share,combined_ratio,pif_total,net_premiums_written,roe_net_income_ttm,gainshare_estimate,investment_book_yield FROM pgr_edgar_monthly WHERE month_end < ? AND filing_date < ? ORDER BY month_end
extraction_sql.splits: SELECT split_date,split_ratio FROM split_history WHERE ticker='PGR' AND split_date < ? ORDER BY split_date

partition_lock.rule: target_end and label availability strictly before the boundary; quarantine definitions inherited from v200 unchanged

calibration.matched: rows where candidate and control are both past warmup
calibration.method: prequential empirical residual quantiles/frequency from the same stream's matured residuals only
calibration.probability: share of matured residuals with forecast + residual above the event threshold

direction.base: constant majority event of labels matured by origin
direction.cash_dividend_12m: next-12M cash strictly above the fixed past-12M control
direction.skill_test: one-sided block test of per-date hit minus base hit, reported raw; a safeguard, not a success route

rules.disposition: Pass only if relative MAE reduction >= .10 vs the matched v200 control, Holm-adjusted primary p < .05 (38-test campaign family, pending slots p=1), delta honest R2 >= .01, candidate hit rate >= control hit rate, candidate Brier <= control Brier, |coverage80-.80| <= control's + .05, scored dates / horizon >= 5 independent blocks and supported block inference. NaN fails.
rules.feature_rows: all registered features finite; no imputation of a missing report month

folds.availability: training labels need target end, filing or label availability and origin before the (inner) test origin; inner validation labels must have arrived by the outer origin
folds.dates: contiguous business month-ends spanning the v200 control origins of each endpoint; unique monthly dates split before any row expansion
folds.h12: outer TimeSeriesSplit 120 train / 6 test / gap 24; inner 3 folds test 6 gap 24, minimum 60 usable months
folds.h6: outer TimeSeriesSplit 60 train / 6 test / gap 12; inner 3 folds test 6 gap 12, minimum 24 usable months
folds.unsupported: unscorable; gaps and support are never reduced

rules.holdout: no quarantine label, feature or metric is read
rules.honest_r2_naive: v200 prevailing mean of same-endpoint labels matured by origin
rules.matched_rows: Outer-test rows with a finite candidate forecast, a finite non-warmup v200 control forecast and naive mean, and a finite label
rules.nomination: At most one winner across both lanes: lowest adjusted p, then largest relative MAE reduction; none if nothing passes
rules.post_result_search: none; no feature, lag, threshold, window or grid change after results
rules.share_basis: Dollar features, targets and offsets are restated to the share basis of each fold's first test origin before fitting; forecasts are restated back to each test origin's basis
